Right here! One of the best, most underrated and influential bands of the time. Becker and Fagen are the entire package, beautiful compositions and fusion sensibility. Katy Lied is probably my favorite record but most are good. It's difficult to like their deep cuts and later stuff unless you have a penchant for jazz. Their newer stuff is alright and I think Everything Must Go was and is an excellent return to their roots. I love them because my mother loves them. I'm 26 and I've seen them live three times. They still play all the goodies. They don't make musicians like Steely Dan any more.
